Supreme Court Suspends Sentence for Bilkis Bano Case Convicts

The Supreme Court of India has suspended the life sentence of two convicts in the 2002 Bilkis Bano rape and murder case, granting them bail. Bilkis Bano has expressed shock at this decision. Following the court's order, Bilkis Bano and her family have left Gujarat.
